description: FREE. Read the leads a search_areas job found, up to 500 per page. Accepts the same filters as the Lyre Leads database, passed as filters, e.g. {"relevanceYes": true, "hasVerifiedEmail": true, "noFBPixel": true}. Each lead comes back compact by default: contact details, business email and its verification state, named contact, relevance verdict with its evidence, software and signals, plus a summary and next steps; detail "full" returns every database field. Enrichment keeps landing for a while after the search finishes, so re-read if leads are still enriching.

detail.description: compact (default) or full (every field, much longer)

filters.description: Database filter parameters as key/value pairs, e.g. {"relevanceYes": true, "minReviews": 100}

name: get_search_results
title: Read a search's leads
